_comment_hooks: PreToolUse guards in two tiers. HARD-DENY (exit 2) for actions never legitimate for the agent: protect-immutable-adrs.sh blocks Edit/Write/MultiEdit on existing docs/adr/NNNN-*.md; protect-lock-files.sh blocks edits to lock files (change them via the package manager); protect-main-branch.sh blocks `git commit` on main/master (branch-first per cbk-conventions.md § Branch naming). ASK-GATE (permissionDecision "ask") for one-way doors legitimate only when operator-instructed — the permission prompt IS the per-action HITL approval, and it fires even when a broad allowlist entry would otherwise auto-approve: guard-pr-state.sh intercepts gh pr ready/merge/close/reopen; require-knowledge-backend-ok.sh intercepts knowledge-backend MCP writes (Notion matcher shipped as the v1 reference — adjust the regex to your MCP's tool names). All guards fail open (exit 0 + stderr warning naming the surviving backstop) on environment defects, so a missing jq can't turn a targeted guard into a universal block. A project may add a PostToolUse advisory formatter — see .claude/hooks/format-on-edit.sh (exemplar; wire its case arms to your stack and register it here).

_example_PostToolUse_formatter._comment: Copy this object into hooks.PostToolUse after wiring .claude/hooks/format-on-edit.sh's case arms to your stack. Advisory tier: exit 0 always.

_comment_enabledPlugins: Plugins the cascade kit expects. Install each via Claude Code's plugin system before running /finish: pr-review-toolkit (the review pass dispatches pr-review-toolkit:review-pr) and commit-commands (staging/commit wrappers used by the kit's examples). `/simplify` — /finish's simplify pass — is built into Claude Code as a bundled skill (verified against the installed CLI bundle, Claude Code 2.1.263, 2026-09-06; re-verify after harness upgrades) and is deliberately NOT listed here: add "simplify": true only if your install ships it as a plugin. Rename entries to match installed plugin IDs if yours differ.
_comment_enabledMcpjsonServers: MCP servers the cascade reads from .mcp.json. Copy .mcp.json.example to .mcp.json and configure the credentials/endpoints for each server you want enabled. Comment out any server you don't use.
